༄༅/ /bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i las byang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i las byang bzhugs so//

tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa bla ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi las byang ni/ gnas dben par pad+ma drag po'i bris sku'i mdun du gtor ma pad 'dab bzhi pa'i steng du/ ril bu gsum gyi steng du ril bu nor bu'i dbyibs can bzhag cing*/ pad+ma'i mthar ril bus bskor ba dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa dang*/ sman raka mchod gtor bshams/ rol mo'i bye brag 'du byas/ sgrub po kha lho nub tu phyogs pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rang rig gdod nas bla ma'i sku// rig mdangs 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// ril rtsal sprul pa'i sku'i rang bzhin// sku gsum gtso la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// 'gro drug don phyir rigs kyi gtso'i// go 'phang thob slad lam zab mo// nyams su blang bar dam bca' 'o// lan gsum/ bgegs la gtor ma byin la/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ nga ni pad+ma drag po rtsal// dmar nag khro rngam gtum pa'i tshul// skal med dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma khyer la dengs// oṃ sarba bhū ta bi nā ya ka uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jigs byed chen po'i thugs ka nas// mtshon cha'i tshogs dang rdo rje'i me// phyogs bcur spros pas rdo rje'i gur// sra brtan dum bu gcig tu gyur// oṃ badz+ra kro dha da sha pra ag+ni rak+ṣa tsakra warti bh+rūṃ/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ rtsa gsum bla ma'i spyan snga ru// bdag gis sngon nas da lta'i bar// dug lnga'i dbang gis mi dge ba// ngan song rgyur gyur bshags shing sdom// oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ a nu rā ga ṇa/ u gra mā ra ya/ sarba pū dza a dhiṣ+ṭhi te ā we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ

lan gsum/ lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ */ gzung 'dzin chos rnams ye nas stong*// dmigs med snying rje phyogs lhung bral// rig ngor hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas// pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i steng*// rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su// gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal// dmar nag 'jigs pa'i cha byad can// gsung gdangs rngam pa'i nga ro ni// hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrog /thugs ni nyon mongs bdud bgegs dang*// bag la nyal gyi tshogs sgrol ba'i// ngang bcas 'gying bag rol stabs can// phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje ni| |rtse dgu rab gdengs phyag g.yon gyis// dngul dkar dril bu dku la brten// khro 'dzum brjid pa gar dgu'i nyams// ye shes spyan gsum nyi zla ltar// phyogs bcur 'khyil zhing gzigs pa'i tshul// tshems kyi phreng ba gangs ri ltar// rab brtan bzhad pa'i nyams can la// smin ma sma ra ag tshom rnams// me dpung mched pa lta bur 'bar| |za 'og ber chen ljang smug gsol// thod pa skam rlon phreng bas brgyan// dbu skra thor tshugs rus rgyan ldan// khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// srid gsum zil gyis gnon par gyur// spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams// rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal| |rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gling nas gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bla ma rigs 'dus lha tshogs rnams// bdag dang gnyis su med pa la// brda yis mtshon nas spyan drangs te// gnyis med ngang du bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs// rang byung thugs rjes 'gro kun sgrol// dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa// pad+ma drag por phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ

pra tīts+tsha hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ lha rdzas mchod yon me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /phyi mchod rnam dag 'bul bar bgyi// dbang po'i me tog sha chen spos// tshil chen mar me dri chu'i chab| |dri chen zhal zas thod rnga dang*// rkang gling nang gi mchod pa 'bul// yab yum mkha' gsang la bskyil ba'i// byang sems dkar dmar gsang mchod 'bul// thabs shes snyoms 'jug bde stong ro// dgyes pa skyed byed sbyor mchod 'bul// zhing bcu'i rlung dang rnam rtog tshogs// bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman| |rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen po// dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa bcas// 'bul gyi bzhes la dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ ma hā sh+ma shā na pū dza/ shu kra/ rak+ta/ a nu rā ga ṇa/ u gra mā ra ya/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya hūm̐ hoḥ rtags bstod ni/ hūm̐ */ chags bral pad+ma gdung sel zla ba dang*// ma rig 'joms pa nyi ma'i gdan steng du// ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal// snying rjes khros pa'i sku mdog dmar la rngam// bdud bzhi rtsad gcod rno dbal mche ba gtsigs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan thabs shes rdor dril bsnams// dug lnga 'joms mdzad rigs lngas dbu la brgyan// 'du byed dag pas rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol// lta ngan rab 'joms ber chen sku la mnabs// lha gdon 'dul mdzad ral pa mkha' la 'phyo// bar snang gza' 'joms spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug /'og gdon 'dul phyir gyad kyi dor stabs tshul// brda rtags mtshon ldan khro rgyal sku la bstod// don bstod ni/ hūm̐ */ skye 'gag gnas 'gyur bral ba chos kyi sku// 'du 'bral med pa bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// rang byung rang shar 'dzin med sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum mnga' bdag pad+ma tshe dbang 'dzin// gsal sgrib med cing bde stong zung du 'jug

/rang mdangs rang gsal ma 'gag du mar 'char// rtsol sgrub byed spyod bral bas gol sa chod// ma bcos 'dzin bral spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// gdod nas grub pa chos sku ye shes che// rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs// mu med rig ngor gang shar sprul pa'i sku// ma lus gcig tu 'dom pa'i ngo bo nyid// rang rig rang gsal pad+ma drag po rtsal// don gyi bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ 'dzab bzla ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa yis// lus kyi phyi nang ma lus pa// hūm̐ gis mer khengs lus nang du// ma shong phyir 'phros stong gsum gyi// 'jig rten ma lus hūm̐ gis khengs// de las hrīḥzhes brjod pa yis// hūm̐ rnams mkha' 'gro dpag med gyur// mkha' 'gro ma tshogs hūm̐ sgra sgrog /phyi nang gsang ba'i bde gshegs dang*// byang sems skye 'gro rtsi shing nags// snang srid lha 'dre gnod byed dang*// tshe srog bar chad ma lus pa// mkha' 'gro mar gyur hūm̐ sgra sgrog /bdag nyid mgrin nang hūm̐ dmar po// byi ru ltar gsal hūm̐ drag tu// brjod pas mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// bro rdung gar stabs shigs shigs mdzad// stong gsum ri rab ldeg ldeg cing*// bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur// de ltar dmigs nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brtsegs mar zhag bdun bzla/ sems kyi bzhag thabs ni/ thugs dgongs brjod bral mkha' dbyings rnam par dag /rang byung rang shar stong gsal 'dzin pa med// skye med ka dag zang thal gnas lugs gsal// gzung 'dzin zhen pa'i thag pa bcad la bzhag /ces pa'i don bsgom/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/ gnyid log dus su snying gar hūm̐ bsgoms nas// de la rig pa gtad de 'phror mi gzhug /hūm̐ yig rtsa yi 'phar grangs bsnyen pa 'grub// nyi khri chig stong zhag gcig bsnyen grangs rdzogs// zhes pa ltar dang*/ nyin mo'i thun mtshams su/

ngal gso'i dus su rtsa bral ngang la bzhag /ces pa ltar bya'o// thun mtshams tshogs mchod ni/ tshogs rdzas ji ltar 'dzoms pa la chu dang sman rak+ta bran/ hūm̐ */ rang rig bla ma'i thugs srog las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros me rlung chus| |tshogs kyi bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus// slar yang oṃ dkar āḥdamar dang*// hūm̐ mthing spros bstims sbyangs spel sbar// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bcas// oṃ āḥhūm̐| lan gsum brjod/ tshogs dang po/ hūm̐ */ 'dod yon lnga ldan longs spyod rdzas// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'dis// rtsa gsum bla ma mchod cing bskang*// skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul blo yis// nongs spyad 'gal ba ci mchis pa// mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// yig brgya brjod/ gsum pa dgra bgegs dgug bstim bsgral/ hūm̐ */ dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba dang*// byang chub bsgrub la bar gcod pa'i// dam sri dgra bgegs 'dir khug la// bsad cing bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs la 'bul// bar chad rtsad gcod dngos grub stsol// ma hā pū dza sarba sha trūṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ zhes 'bul lo| |slar yang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon lnga// 'od kyis bsdus nas tshogs la bstim// 'khor los sgyur rgyal pho brang dang*// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis brgyad// rtsi dang 'bru sman rin chen dang*// bdud rtsi'i bcud kun bsdus la bstim// zhes dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ nā nā khā de sid+dhi pad+ma sid+dhi dha na mi dhe hrīḥ.ā yuḥsid+dhi sa ma ya 'dus 'dus/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas la/ tshogs dngos grub tu bsams la rol/ lhag ma bsdus par/ slob dpon gyis chang gi kha khrus bran la/ a kā ro gsum dang*/

hūm̐ */ phud dang bar pa tha ma yi// longs spyod 'byor pas rnam bzhi'i mgron| |mchod cing brngan phyir 'bul lags kyi/ tshim par bzhes la dngos grub stsol// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa sarba pa ti khā hi/ zhes 'bul/// / ༈ /slob ma la dbang bskur na/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug blangs| yig brgya bzlas pa'i chus slob ma khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kyai/ ma hā gu ru sprul pa'i sku// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis// 'gro ba 'dul phyir bdag la dbang*// brtse bar dgongs la bstsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sngar gyi skyabs sems bya// slob ma gong ltar lhar bskyed/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge'i 'od kyis ye shes pa sngar gyi spyan 'dren gyis bskul la bstim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ bris sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma drag po rtsal// gzi brjid dpal 'bar mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// bag chags lus kyi nyes pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: mgrin par hūm̐ yig gtad/ bdud rtsi khar sbyin zhing*| āḥ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags kun 'dus pa// snying po hūm̐ yig drag cing ngar ldang can// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'chal ba ngag gi nyes pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ shel rdo snying gar gtugs la/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs ma lus thugs kyi dgongs pa ni// ma bcos rang byung stong gsal skyon dang bral// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'khrul ba yid kyi nyes pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'khor lo lte bar gtad la/ swā/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs rin po che// kun la dbang bskur 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'bar// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'dzin byed zhen snang nyes pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā:

kha dog lnga ldan yan lag lnga la gtad/ hā/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa phrin las stobs po che// rnam bzhi gang la gang 'dul der ston pa// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// dug lnga bag chags nyes pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ gu ru pad+ma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: gtor ma dang sman rak+ta sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐ */ snod bcud rnam dag gtor ma sman raka bcas// dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma mchod pa'i rdzas// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// thugs rje'i gdul bya phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /oṃ ba ling+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gtad la/ rjes dam tshig khas blang gtang rag dbul/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ rang byung gnyug ma'i pho brang nas// rang sems pad+ma drag po rtsal// rang rig dbang gi thugs dam bskul// rang snang nyon mongs dag choms la// rang gshis chos skur la zlos shog /sa ma ya aḥ chad mdo'i gtor mar sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ dus gsum dus la bab pa'i tshe// 'og min la sogs gnas rnams su// lha sras skye rgyud dbang bskur tshe// srung ma'i tshogs kyis khas blangs pa// ji ltar gtor ma 'di bzhes la// chos ldan phrin las myur sgrubs shig /ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ tshogs gzhong sman 'bru 'dod yon gyis bkang bar sman raka bran la/ bh+yoḥ dam la btags pa'i brtan ma ni// skyong ma yang ma'i tshogs dang bcas// 'dir byon gser skyems mchod pa bzhes// rnal 'byor dam skong phrin las sgrubs// ma ma shā sa ni sa pa ri wā ra pū dza khā hi/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs la/ hūm̐ */ nyon mongs bag chags phung khams tshogs// ye shes ngang du mnan cing gzir// rtogs pas ka dag zang thal ngang*// gzhom med rdo rje'i glu bro bgyi// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ gtor ma dang sman raka la sngar tshogs 'khor skabs kyi dngos grub kyi dmigs pa dang*/

sngags bzla zhing dngos grub tu dmigs la rol/ hūm̐ */ rang rig gzhi gnas pad+ma drag po rtsal// lam du gang shar der snang bla ma'i sku// 'bras bu sku dang ye shes rang la gnas// gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' rang snang rang la rdzogs// oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma rje// bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'di| |khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// bla ma'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces smon lam gdab/ hūm̐ */ byin rlabs bla ma'i bkra shis byin re che// dngos grub yi dam bkra shis dwangs re spro// phrin las mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis rtsal re che/ /rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pas dge legs stsol/ /ces shis pa brjod do/ /de ltar tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsang sgrub kyi las byang mdor bsdus pa 'di yang*/ gter gzhung du/ las gzhung dag ni lha brag pa las bsgyur/ zhes byang gter gyi thugs sgrub 'bring pos 'gebs dgos par gsungs pa ltar de nyid nas tshig sna bstungs te bris pa 'di yang*/ 'on rin chen brag gi gdan sa ba bla ma dkon mchog lhun grub sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ rang nor rang gis longs spyod par dbang ba'i bsam pas sa byi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
